fix: Avoid cloning every Route per frame. Add a non-cloning accessor on Navigator (for example `pub fn route_ids(&self, out: &mut Vec<RouteId>)` or a `with_routes(|entries| ..)` visitor that borrows state) and build the FrameAttempt from ids only, e.g. `FrameAttempt::of_ids(navigator.revision(), ids)` with `active = ids.last().copied()` and `members` filled from the same buffer. `begin_frame` calls `FrameAttempt::capture` once per driven frame (line 1406), so this removes a full stack clone plus a second Vec per frame.

`live_nested()` collects a fresh Vec of Rc clones on every call, and present_frame runs preflight_tree, check_drivers and claim_tree on every frame (lines 1319-1321, 1370), once per outlet in the tree. Iterate the borrowed Weak list instead, with no allocation: `for nested in self.nested.borrow().iter().filter_map(Weak::upgrade) { nested.borrow().preflight_tree()?; }`. The same change applies to `check_drivers` (line 701) and `claim_tree` (line 711). No callbacks run during these walks, so holding the immutable `nested` borrow across the recursive call is safe (cycles are rejected at attach time).

Only reached when `host_overlay_routes` is false, but then it runs every frame through preflight_tree and clones the whole stack (`routes()` returns an owned Vec<Route>) just to find overlay entries. Check without cloning: iterate borrowed state through the non-cloning navigator accessor from the capture finding, returning Err only when a matching route exists, and collect the ids into the error only on that failure path.

Emptiness only needs the stack length. Replace with a non-cloning check, e.g. `None => !self.navigator.is_empty()` (add a `Navigator::is_empty`/`len` that reads `state.routes.len()`), so `needs_frame` does not clone every Route when no composition has been consumed yet.

The focus ownership oracle allocates an ancestor Vec on every call and then scans it with `chain.contains` for each nested and tagged outlet. The oracle runs on focus transitions and retries, not per element, so the cost is modest. Use a stack-allocated buffer (`smallvec::SmallVec<[ElementId; 16]>` if incular-runtime already depends on smallvec) or a reusable buffer held in the outlet, or walk the ancestor chain once and compare each candidate root against the walk without storing it.
